title: Trusted access for the next era of cyber defense
raw_excerpt: OpenAI expands its Trusted Access for Cyber program, introducing GPT-5.4-Cyber to vetted defenders and strengthening safeguards as AI cybersecurity capabilities advance.
summary: OpenAI 宣布扩大其网络安全信任访问计划，推出专为防御者设计的 GPT-5.4-Cyber 模型，并加强安全防护措施。此举标志着 AI 网络安全能力进入新阶段，同时 Anthropic 也因 Claude Mythos 的先进网络能力而限制其公开发布。该事件凸显了前沿 AI 模型在网络安全领域的双刃剑效应，以及行业对负责任部署的重视。

title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: Powering real-world robotics tasks through enhanced embodied reasoning
raw_excerpt: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6: Enhancing spatial reasoning and multi-view understanding for autonomous robotics.
summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6，通过增强空间推理和多视角理解能力，提升机器人在真实世界中的自主操作性能。该模型在复杂环境下的物体识别与操作任务上取得显著进步，为机器人从实验室走向实际应用提供了关键技术支持，是具身智能领域的重要里程碑。

title: Anthropic tests Claude Code upgrade to rival Codex Superapp
raw_excerpt: Anthropic is planning to overhaul the Claude Code desktop experience. It is also developing a 'Coordinator Mode' that would let Claude act as an orchestrator and delegate implementation work across parallel sub-agents while focusing on planning and synthesis. Claude Code already supports sub-agents and experimental agent teams in the CLI, but the new mode brings that capability into the desktop app with a more structured interface.
summary: Anthropic 正在测试 Claude Code 的重大升级，计划引入“协调模式”，使 Claude 能够作为编排器将任务分解给多个并行子代理，同时自身专注于规划与合成。这一改进将提升复杂项目中的多代理协作效率，与 OpenAI 的 Codex 超级应用形成直接竞争，标志着 AI 编程助手从单线程向多智能体协作的演进。

title: OpenAI develops unified Codex app and new Scratchpad feature
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's new Scratchpad feature for Codex allows users to trigger multiple Codex tasks in parallel from a new UI. The company is moving toward consolidating its product lineup into a single unified application built on top of Codex. There is evidence that the company is building support for managed agents, autonomous processes that can run in the background, check in periodically, and execute multi-step workflows without user input. OpenAI employees have been posting snowflake emojis on essential media, possibly hinting at a model released codenamed Glacier believed to be GPT-5.5.
summary: OpenAI 正在开发统一的 Codex 超级应用，新增 Scratchpad 功能支持并行触发多个 Codex 任务，并计划整合 ChatGPT 和 Atlas 浏览器。同时，OpenAI 员工暗示代号“Glacier”的 GPT-5.5 模型即将发布。此举表明 OpenAI 正加速构建一体化 AI 开发平台，以应对 Anthropic 和 xAI 的竞争。

title: Evaluation of Claude Mythos Preview's cyber capabilities
summary: 英国 AI 安全研究所（AISI）发布了对 Anthropic Claude Mythos 预览版网络能力的评估报告。该模型展现出极高的自主漏洞发现与利用能力，引发安全担忧。AISI 的评估为前沿 AI 模型的危险性提供了独立证据，也推动了全球关于 AI 安全监管的讨论。

title: The AI revolution in math has arrived
summary: 《量子杂志》报道称，AI 在数学领域的革命已经到来。近期多个研究显示，AI 在定理证明、猜想生成和数学推理方面取得了突破性进展，例如 DeepMind 的 AlphaProof 和 OpenAI 的 o3 模型在 IMO 难题上的表现。这标志着 AI 从辅助计算工具向数学发现伙伴的转变，可能重塑数学研究范式。

title: N-Day-Bench – Can LLMs find real vulnerabilities in real codebases?
raw_excerpt:
N-Day-Bench tests whether frontier LLMs can find known security vulnerabilities in real repository code. Each month it pulls fresh cases from GitHub security advisories, checks out the repo at the last commit before the patch, and gives models a sandboxed bash shell to explore the codebase.

Static vulnerability discovery benchmarks become outdated quickly. Cases leak into training data, and scores start measuring memorization. The monthly refresh keeps the test set ahead of contamination — or at least makes the contamination window honest.

Each case runs three agents: a Curator reads the advisory and builds an answer key, a Finder (the model under test) gets 24 shell steps to explore the code and write a structured report, and a Judge scores the blinded submission. The Finder never se…
summary: N-Day-Bench 是一个新的基准测试，用于评估前沿 LLM 在真实代码库中发现已知安全漏洞的能力。它每月从 GitHub 安全公告中提取新案例，确保测试集不被污染。初步结果显示，即使是最先进的模型也仅能发现约 30% 的漏洞，揭示了 AI 在真实世界漏洞挖掘中的巨大差距。

title: Cram Less to Fit More: Training Data Pruning Improves Memorization of Facts
raw_excerpt: Training data pruning improves LLMs' fact memorization, reducing hallucinations and enhancing performance on knowledge-intensive tasks. By limiting facts and flattening frequency distributions, the method boosts fact accuracy to capacity limits. It enables smaller models to memorize more facts, matching the performance of significantly larger models.
summary: 苹果机器学习研究团队发现，训练数据剪枝（pruning）可以显著提高 LLM 对事实的记忆能力，减少幻觉。通过限制事实数量并平滑频率分布，该方法使小模型在知识密集型任务上达到大模型的性能。这一发现为高效训练更可靠的语言模型提供了新思路。

title: Latent Briefing: Efficient Memory Sharing for Multi-Agent Systems via KV Cache Compaction
raw_excerpt: Multi-agent systems are often highly token inefficient. A lot of redundant intermediate reasoning can emerge, especially as the task grows, and this causes token usage to compound rapidly. Latent Briefing is an approach to solving this problem that uses a model's attention patterns to identify which parts of context are important and discards the rest at the representation level. It shares relevant memory between agents, resulting in improved accuracy and token savings.
summary: Ramp Labs 提出 Latent Briefing 方法，通过利用模型的注意力模式识别关键上下文，在表示层面压缩 KV 缓存，实现多智能体系统间的高效记忆共享。该方法减少了冗余推理带来的 token 消耗，在提升准确率的同时节省大量计算资源，为构建大规模多智能体系统提供了实用方案。

title: Your Agent Is Mine: Measuring Malicious Intermediary Attacks on the LLM Supply Chain
raw_excerpt: Researchers identified vulnerabilities in LLM API routers, finding 1 paid and 8 free routers injecting malicious code. They developed "Mine," a proxy simulating attacks, revealing risks like payload injection and secret exfiltration.
summary: 研究人员发现 LLM API 路由器中存在严重安全漏洞，在 1 个付费和 8 个免费路由器中检测到恶意代码注入。他们开发了“Mine”代理模拟攻击，揭示了载荷注入和秘密窃取等风险。该研究警示，随着 LLM 供应链的复杂化，中间人攻击成为新的重大威胁。
